protocol.data: Train Session1 only; pseudo-time holdout, not cross-session evidence
protocol.inner: leave one of three registered subjects out as pseudo-unknown; score selection only
protocol.threshold: 5th percentile of disjoint calibration trials from all three registered subjects
protocol.outer: all remaining registered trials + all trials of 17 unknown subjects
protocol.inference: per-trial, no metadata rejection, batch alignment, graph fusion or Sinkhorn
protocol.scenario_note: trial counts and task-specific evaluation are simulation choices, not claimed final rules
